contract.seed_scope: One content-attested frozen seed copied into a distinct writable root for each episode
contract.solver_visibility: outside the observation, constraint, and operation layers
close_audit: preserve and hash service logs before removing containers
stop services before hashing cache state
normalize container-written ownership on native Linux
verify the seed manifest file and seed contents are unchanged
record the episode-only final content manifest and byte delta

canary.replay: repeat the online-miss command in another fresh client
canary.success_criterion: all commands exit zero; one upstream file read is followed by a cache-only replay; source seed remains unchanged

development_failures_resolved.failure: Native Linux clients could not reach ports published only on host loopback.
development_failures_resolved.resolution: Bind native Linux services only to the Docker bridge gateway and retain loopback binding on Docker Desktop.

development_failures_resolved.failure: Root-written DevPI metadata was unreadable to the native Linux coordinator during final hashing.
development_failures_resolved.resolution: After service shutdown, use the attested local apt image to normalize ownership inside only the writable episode copy.

development_failures_resolved.failure: A Mac development attempt timed out upstream while the same network carried the 2.896 GB Spark seed transfer.
development_failures_resolved.resolution: Classified as network contention; the unchanged trial passed after transfer stopped, and the final qualification had zero upstream timeouts.

verification.credential_scan: no API key, VPN subscription, or Spark password pattern found

limitations: The canary exercises PyPI hit and miss behavior; apt-cacher-ng was built, started, health-checked, and audited but no new apt payload was requested.
Wall-clock values include external network conditions and are qualification observations, not performance estimates.
The evidence archive preserves service logs, leases, attestations, and final manifests; client stdout was observed live but is not archived.
No EnvBench case or deployment algorithm was executed in this qualification.
conclusion: The isolated seeded cache lifecycle is operational on both Mac Docker Desktop ARM64 and DGX Spark native Linux ARM64. It preserves an open online operation space, prevents cross-episode cache mutation, and retains auditable hit/miss evidence without entering the EnvSolve-Pro algorithm.
